rites.name: Northern Autocephalous Rite
rites.description: Venerates local Northern Saints, preserves married parish clergy, and answers to the Metropolitan at St. Cyril's.

rites.name: Imperial Orthodox Rite
rites.description: Recognizes the Southern Patriarch of Heliodor and standardized liturgical canons.

rites.name: Hesychast Monastic Tradition
rites.description: Contemplative stillness practiced in forest hermitages; views mana as a created echo of uncreated light.

initial_texts.title: The Frost Canon
initial_texts.author: St. Cyril of Nordmark
initial_texts.doctrine: Establishes winter fasts, parish alms, and Northern altar hymns.

initial_texts.title: Homilies of St. Cyril
initial_texts.author: Abbot Arsenius
initial_texts.doctrine: Defends married village priests and serf sanctuary rights during famine.

initial_texts.title: Treatise on the Uncreated Mana
initial_texts.author: Metropolitan Seraphim
initial_texts.doctrine: Distinguishes divine grace from elemental mana to justify silent prayer healing.

initial_texts.title: Chronicle of the First Margraves
initial_texts.author: Master Vaelen's Scribe
initial_texts.doctrine: Records House Vaelen's compact with the Southern Empire at South Pass.
